import re, glob, datetime, collections

files = sorted(glob.glob('/app/logs/*.log'))
sev_re = re.compile(r'\[(ERROR|WARNING|INFO|DEBUG|TRACE|FATAL|CRITICAL|ALERT|EMERG)\]')
counts = collections.Counter()
date_sev = collections.defaultdict(collections.Counter)

for f in files:
    fname = f.split('/')[-1]
    m = re.match(r'^(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})_', fname)
    d = m.group(1)
    for line in open(f):
        line=line.rstrip('\n')
        mm = re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \[(\w+)\]', line)
        s = mm.group(1) if mm else None
        counts[s]+=1
        if s in ('ERROR','WARNING','INFO'):
            date_sev[d][s]+=1

print("ALL lines by severity:", dict(counts))

ref = datetime.date(2025,8,12)
def in_range(dstr, lo, hi):
    d = datetime.date.fromisoformat(dstr)
    return lo <= d <= hi

today = '2025-08-12'
last7 = (ref - datetime.timedelta(days=6), ref)
last30 = (ref - datetime.timedelta(days=29), ref)
mtd_lo = datetime.date(2025,8,1); mtd_hi = ref

ranges = {
 'today': [(today, True)],
 'last_7_days': [(d.isoformat(), True) for d in [ref-datetime.timedelta(days=i) for i in range(6,-1,-1)]],
 'last_30_days': [(d.isoformat(), True) for d in [ref-datetime.timedelta(days=i) for i in range(29,-1,-1)]],
 'month_to_date': [(d.isoformat(), True) for d in sorted(date_sev.keys() if False else [f'2025-08-{i:02d}' for i in range(1,13)]) if d <= '2025-08-12'],
}

def total_in(lo, hi):
    tot = collections.Counter()
    for d,c in date_sev.items():
        dd = datetime.date.fromisoformat(d)
        if lo <= dd <= hi:
            tot.update(c)
    return tot

def get_period(name):
    if name=='today':
        return dict(date_sev.get('2025-08-12', {}))
    if name=='last_7_days':
        lo = datetime.date(2025,8,6); hi=ref
    elif name=='last_30_days':
        lo = datetime.date(2025,7,14); hi=ref
    elif name=='month_to_date':
        lo = datetime.date(2025,8,1); hi=ref
    return dict(total_in(lo,hi))

for name in ['today','last_7_days','last_30_days','month_to_date']:
    c = get_period(name)
    print(name, {k:c.get(k,0) for k in ['ERROR','WARNING','INFO']}, "lines in range:", sum(c.values()))

tot = collections.Counter()
for d,c in date_sev.items():
    tot.update(c)
print('total(valid sevs)', dict(tot))

# also per-file totals for sanity
per_day = collections.Counter()
for f in files:
    fn=f.split('/')[-1]
    d=fn.split('_')[0]
    c=collections.Counter()
    for line in open(f):
        m=re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2} \[(\w+)\]', line)
        c[m.group(1)]+=1
    per_day[d]=c
import json
json.dump({d:{k:v for k,v in c.items()} for d,c in per_day.items()}, open('/tmp/per_day.json','w'))
EOF
